description: Set up a friends challenge. The user gets a code and an invite to paste into their group chat (texts, WhatsApp, anything), and everyone who joins plays the same secret word by the daily's rules: six shots, a hint is a shot, fewest shots wins, ties go to the fastest. The user plays their own round right away, like a daily round, with the challenge code on every call. Joining stays open for 2 hours (or 1 or 3, their pick) for up to 8 players, and the board stays hidden until everyone's done or 24 hours pass. Pass rematch with a finished challenge's code to play the same group again with a new word.

ai_name.description: The name the user calls you, e.g. "Boo" or "Claude".

join_hours.description: How long friends can join: 1, 2 or 3 hours. 2 unless the user says.

name.description: The first name the user's friends know them by, shown on challenge boards. Ask once if you don't know it.

platform.description: The assistant product you run in: "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Muse", "Grok", "Gemini", "Hermes", "Instinct", or another name.

player.description: The player code from start_round, e.g. "brave-otter-4821". The same code in every chat keeps the streak going.

rematch.description: A finished challenge's code, for a rematch with the same group and a new word.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Always send it when you know it: the day changes at the user's local midnight, and Get Out & Go runs from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. on their clock. Ask for their city if you don't know.

name: start_challenge
title: Start a Show & Tell challenge
